excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content:
For our Kurtosis devnet, we reuse ordinary EIP-2335 BLS validator keystores and their passwords. We haven’t introduced a separate PQ keystore format.

  The VC loading procedure is:
1. Import/decrypt the usual validator keystores.
2. Serialize each BLS signing secret as exactly 32 big-endian bytes.
3. Derive:
     xmss_seed = SHA256(b"leanxmss-seed" + bls_sk_bytes)
     vrf_seed  = SHA256(b"vrf-seed" + bls_sk_bytes)
4. Initialize the leanXMSS signer from xmss_seed and construct the VRF tree using our agreed genesis convention.
5. Find the validator in the beacon state using the derived XMSS public key, not the original BLS public key.
6. Use XMSS signatures and VRF proofs for PQ duties.

The keystore’s existing pubkey field remains its BLS public key. It identifies the imported keystore; it is not the PQ validator’s on-chain public key. No keystore rewriting is necessary.
Lighthouse prepares XMSS keys during loading and computes/caches each VRF tree on first use. We currently support local keystores only for PQ signing.
This is our devnet convention, not a standardized PQ keystore/import format. The pinned consensus spec defines the signing/VRF behavior but does not prescribe this BLS-keystore derivation or a common VC import interface. Other clients can retain their normal keystore-loading CLI, provided they perform these derivations and match the genesis roots.

Reference implementation (https://github.com/ethDreamer/lighthouse/blob/0c76c6e14f4f043acbf40fdc42a0eb64dbf94224/validator_client/lighthouse_validator_store/src/pq.rs) · Genesis/VRF convention
  (https://github.com/ethDreamer/lighthouse/blob/0c76c6e14f4f043acbf40fdc42a0eb64dbf94224/scripts/local_testnet/pq-genesis/README.md)

I tried an earlier pq-gasper image (165fee6, index 7cd32c924b95…) with LH in Kurtosis: genesis roots matched, but Lodestar stayed at slot 0 and rejected LH's first block with `LeanvmUnavailable`.

I also probed ARM64 index `5376798663730d61762afb7f5a553786b116a56b594d84f0cb19602e5f0978c1`: importing `LEANVM_AVAILABLE` from `./bindings/src/leanvm.js` returned false, consistent with Barnabas's finding above. That second check was a native-module probe, not a fresh network run.

The older image additionally imported the ordinary BLS keystores as BLS signers, so its 32 validators appeared pending against our XMSS genesis. I haven't rechecked that import path in the newer image.

Current LH release `0c76c6e14f` also still uses padded Keccak VRF trees (first 2^20 leaves populated), so it needs matching genesis roots; full-tree state loading isn't implemented in that image yet.

excerpts.author: ethdreamer
excerpts.content:
Current LH image `0c76c6e14f` doesn't match full-tree roots yet: it hashes the first 2^20 leaves and pads the remainder with zero leaves. Even proofs for slot 0 therefore have a different root.

To match your full 2^31 genesis without rebuilding the whole tree, the VC needs the 1028-byte record you described (root32 | slot u32 LE | 31 siblings). For slot-0 records it can retain siblings at heights 20..30, compute the bottom 2^20-leaf subtree from the existing VRF seed, and combine them to verify the registered on-chain root. Every proof then uses that computed bottom path plus the imported upper siblings. It must reject a root mismatch and must not fall back to zero padding.

That state-loading path isn't in the published image yet. The existing keystore/seed derivation remains unchanged; the all-Keccak mnemonic derivation proposed in the main channel would be a separate genesis/key change.
